mapper.insert: insert into monitor_task_log ( id, request_id, request_url, action_type, system_code, task_code, biz_date, run_times, request_json, result_status, error_msg, created_time ) values ( #{id}, #{requestId}, #{requestUrl}, #{actionType}, #{systemCode}, #{taskCode}, #{bizDate}, #{runTimes}, #{requestJson}, #{resultStatus}, #{errorMsg}, now() )
mapper.select: select request_id, action_type as event_type, created_time as event_time, result_status, '' as error_code, error_msg as error_message from monitor_task_log where biz_date = #{bizDate} and task_code = #{taskCode} order by created_time desc, id desc
